svg.title: T14.6_decoder_register_map_configuration_flow
svg.text: T14.6 Decoder Register Map and Configuration Flow
Protocol-derived fields, scheduler context and implementation policy are locked into one auditable hardware task.

text.tspan: Algorithm parameters: Turbo K/f1/f2/E/Ncb, LDPC BG/Zc/k0/E,
Scheduler context: MCS, Qm, target rate, TBS, RV, HARQ process,
Configured limits: HARQ process count, CBG capability, MCS
tables and serving-cell context. Exact fields pending where noted.
List size, max iterations, timeout, trace mask, IRQ enable, LLR
K, f1, f2, E, Ncb, max_iter
BG, Zc, iLS, E, Ncb, max_iter
start, abort, busy, done, error, irq,

g.text: Configuration FSM: descriptor writes are mutable only before LOCK_DESCRIPTOR

text.tspan: family, K/N/E, cb index, llr width
selects engine and input/output buffer size
HARQ ID, NDI, RV, CBG mask, CBGFI
selects old evidence, flush/combine and release policy
K, f1, f2, E, Ncb, max iter
drives LTE Turbo interleaver and circular-buffer recovery
BG, Zc, iLS, k0, E, Ncb
38.212 LDPC segmentation, lifting and bit selection
drives parity-check schedule, address generator and RV window
N, K, E, list size, CRC type
drives frozen mask, rate recovery and CA-SCL selector
start, abort, busy, pass/fail, error code, IRQ
turns protocol task into a recoverable hardware transaction
writes after LOCK_DESCRIPTOR either ignored or raise ERR_WRITE_WHILE_BUSY
list_size and max_iterations are implementation policy, not 3GPP forced values
trace descriptor hash, bad field id, source group and final status for every task
